verdict.rationale: Relay explicitly supports defining user roles alongside card issuance and spend limits (relay-docs-2), but there is no documentation of granular permission structures spanning locations or departments, nor detailed role hierarchies. Community feedback also notes some users encountering issues with permissions, adding uncertainty to how robust the feature is in practice. missing for 10: documentation on department/location-based permission scoping, detailed role hierarchy or custom permission sets, and independent verification that permissions work reliably at scale.
